item.description: Ever since the release of the Jana Nayagan trailer, fans have expressed their disappointment, pointing out similarities between certain scenes and Nandamuri Balakrishna's film Bhagavanth Kesari. Read on for more details.

item.title: BCB instructed to shift T20 World Cup 2026 matches from India after Mustafizur's exit from IPL
item.description: The Bangladesh government advisor, Asif Nazrul, has instructed the Bangladesh Cricket Board to seek a change in the team's T20 World Cup matches from India to Sri Lanka. This came after Mustafizur Rahman's exit from the IPL 2026.

item.title: 'Happy New Year, good night': Handcuffed Maduro brought to US drug agency office | VIDEO
item.description: Earlier, US President Donald Trump had also shared a photo of Maduro on Truth Social showing him wearing a sweatsuit and a blindfold on board the USS Iwo Jima. item.title: Ashish Vidyarthi shares health update following road accident with wife: 'We both are fine'
item.description: Actor Ashish Vidyarthi took to his Instagram handle to share a health update after he and his wife, Rupali Barua, were involved in a road accident in Guwahati on January 2, 2026. He assured his fans that they are doing fine. Watch the video here.

item.title: Teen girl sexually harassed by three minors in Karnataka's Hubbali; case registered
item.description: A 13-year-old girl was sexually harassed by three minors, aged 14 to 15. They had been assaulting the teen for over a week as the girl's parents were away during the day.

item.title: US strikes Venezuela, captures Nicolas Maduro, but is it legal under international law? EXPLAINED
item.description: Nicolas Maduro, who has been in power since 2013, has long been accused of being an 'illegitimate' ruler of Venezuela by the US. It has said that Maduro's regime is harbouring drug traffickers and narco-terrorist networks.

item.title: Odisha: Several feared dead in massive explosion at stone quarry in Dhenkanal; rescue ops underway
item.description: Odisha stone mine blast: Local media reports suggest that the rocks collapsed due to a blast. However, officials said that they are investigating in what caused the accident.

item.title: Kareena Kapoor’s nutritionist Rujuta Diwekar recommends winter foods from across India
item.description: Celebrity nutritionist Rujuta Diwekar shares winter foods from different parts of India, from flaxseed chutney to cholai, explaining why seasonal, regional eating boosts digestion, immunity and overall health during winter.

item.title: Delhi double murder: Elderly couple found dead in Shahdara; police launch probe
item.description: The deceased were identified as Parvesh Bansal (Age 65 years) and Virender Kumar Bansal (Age 75 years). The couple's son called the police to inform them that his parents were lying unconscious at their house in Ram Nagar Extension.
